description.value: A 25-metre, 8-lane outdoor competition pool operated by Recreation Excellence on behalf of the City of Abbotsford. The facility features a rope swing, splashpad, playground, and a covered picnic shelter on the grounds. Fully wheelchair-accessible with ramp water entry, water wheelchair, and barrier-free change rooms—a welcome stop for touring cyclists looking to cool off on a hot day.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: wall_loops (12 spaces) at 70m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Centennial Outdoor Pool at 2310 Emerson St, Abbotsford, operated by Recreation Excellence on behalf of the City of Abbotsford. The site describes barrier-free change rooms with sinks, toilets, and showers, plus a barrier-free drinking fountain as a building feature—confirming washrooms and potable water. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. The OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the facility is clearly in Abbotsford. OSM name is 'Centennial Pool' while the website consistently says 'Centennial Outdoor Pool'.
